# Contributor's Guide

First of all, thank you for contributing to Highcharts React! :+1: :confetti_ball:

This file outlines the guidelines for contributing to the Highcharts React
repository, as well as writing good issue reports.

## How This Repository Works

The code in this repository is generated by a tool that the Highcharts team
maintains in a private repository, and each release replaces the files here.
For this reason, we can't merge pull requests in this repository directly.

Your contributions are still welcome. We review them, and if we accept a
change, we make it in the generator so that it ships in a future release.

## Reporting Bugs and Suggesting Features

We track bugs and feature requests on the repository's
[GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/highcharts/highcharts-react/issues).
Before submitting a new issue, please try to search existing (open and closed)
issues to see if it is already reported. When you open a new issue, please
follow the template.

## Contributing Code

We strongly encourage contributors to open an issue for discussion before
investing significant time in a pull request, especially for non-trivial
changes. Your pull request should focus on a single problem and link to the
related issue.

The
[Licensing and Legal](https://github.com/highcharts/highcharts/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#licensing-and-legal)
and [Use of AI Tools](https://github.com/highcharts/highcharts/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#use-of-ai-tools)
rules from the Highcharts repository also apply here.
